**LaküenPlay v1.2 – PC** is a stability, rendering and quality-of-life update to the Linux fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) **build 130** for desktop Linux and SteamOS PCs.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This is an unofficial fork, not an official Lichii release. Please report problems [here](https://github.com/elkarbeenus/Lichii_improvments_ram/issues), not upstream. Games, keys and firmware are not included: only use content you have legally obtained.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.2-PC-x86_64-pgo.AppImage` | **Recommended.** Self-contained, compiled with profile-guided optimization |
| `LakuenPlay-v1.2-PC-x86_64.AppImage` | The same program without PGO, for comparison |
| `*.tar.gz` | Plain binaries that use your system libraries |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums |

Make the AppImage executable (`chmod +x LakuenPlay-*.AppImage`) and run it. Data folders and settings are shared with Lichii, v1.0 and v1.1.

## What's new since v1.1

### New
- **Save Data Transfer.** Right-click a game in the list → *Save Data Transfer* to export its save as a zip, or import one. Before an import the current save is backed up to `save_backups/<title id>/`. Not available while a game is running.
- **Native HDR output** (HDR10 / scRGB passthrough, *Off / Auto / On*). Off by default ([Lichii #1326](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1326)).
- **Recommended settings** in the Help menu, offered once with a way back ([Lichii #1200](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1200)).

### Performance
- **Evicted graphics pipelines are rebuilt from the kept SPIR-V** instead of being translated again ([Lichii #1337](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1337)).
- **AMD drivers may overallocate device memory** instead of failing an allocation ([Lichii #1335](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1335)).
- **Pipeline misses during play translate their stages in parallel.**
- **The shader cache file is mapped instead of copied into the heap** (Linux).
- **The texture cache collects faster the further it is past its critical memory** (port of [Lichii #1306](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1306)).
- **Freed heap goes back to Linux** after the boot builds and evictions (port of [Lichii #1271](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1271)).
- **Instance loops reach the GPU as one count** (from [Lichii #1274](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1274)).
- **No perf-map lock per compiled CPU block** unless profiling is set up (port of [Lichii #1265](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1265)).
- **The zero-page cleanup runs early after an area change**, and the GPU's back thread gives way to a reader waiting for the buffer lock.

### Rendering fixes
- **Draws without depth are never skipped while their pipeline builds**, so surfaces no longer flash too bright or vanish for a moment (from [Eglantine](https://github.com/Djihads80/Eglantine) 7a940ca19d).
- **Shader fixes:** unsigned clamps ([Lichii #1347](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1347)), 3D surface reductions, bindless offset gathers and geometry attribute loads ([Lichii #1363](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1363)), TLD4.B with a register handle and IMAD with a negated constant ([Lichii #851](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/851)), and constant-buffer abs/neg on float-to-integer conversions (fixes a black sky).
- **2D-engine blits between 3D surfaces are copied slice by slice** ([Lichii #853](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/853)).
- **A damaged texture member in an NUP archive is served by a sibling texture** (port of [Lichii #1197](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1197)).

### Stability
- **Timed events after a pause no longer run too fast** ([Lichii #852](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/852)).
- **Pending GPU commands are flushed before a fence release is forced again** (port of [Lichii #1267](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1267)).
- **Audio:** the system mixer queue is sized to the host's audio callback ([Lichii #850](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/850)).
- **Loading:** applying settings no longer waits for the time services ([Lichii #1168](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/1168)), and the kernel shuts down cleanly when no loader is found ([Lichii #972](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/972)).
